setup: Actual TanStack app and server functions. Test-only requireWorkspace uses an isolated migrated PGlite database; Clerk and Neon connections are not exercised.

results.name: Open traffic, inspect an event, and filter without losing the inspector
Three rapid Send clicks commit three ordered events and select the newest
A failed advance refreshes and the next queued click still commits
Live ticks while clicks are pending are skipped and do not pile up
Live commits away from traffic and selects that event when traffic is reopened
A successful advance with a hung refresh releases the guard after 30 seconds
A hung advance followed by a hung refresh releases queued clicks within 60 seconds
An advance whose pre-transaction read exceeds its deadline commits nothing
A write exceeding the original deadline rolls back its event, state writes, and cursor
Fewer than four milliseconds remaining rejects before opening a transaction
